questions.question: When driving in traffic, what is safest?

options.text: Change your speed to stay alert.
Drive at the same speed as other cars.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive at the same speed as other cars.
questions.explanation: Crashes happen when drivers go faster or slower than other cars. Drive at the same speed as the traffic around you, but do not exceed the speed limit.

questions.question: Lanes going in the same direction are divided by ____ lines.
questions.explanation: White lines separate lanes going in the same direction. Broken white lines can be crossed to pass. Yellow lines separate traffic going in opposite directions.

questions.question: When can you carefully continue through a yellow light?

options.text: When an emergency vehicle is crossing your lane.
When you are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow.
questions.explanation: If you are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow, you should continue through carefully.

questions.question: The best place to keep a space cushion around your car is:

options.text: Only on the left and right sides.

questions.explanation: Keep space on all sides of your car so you have time to react to dangers. Do not drive too close to cars on your left and right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: It warns about road conditions ahead.
It shows the way to cities and towns.
It tells you the traffic rules.

questions.correctAnswerText: It warns about road conditions ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols on a yellow background. They tell you about conditions ahead on or near the road.

questions.question: What does a green arrow traffic signal mean?

options.text: It is used only on one-way streets.
It means you can go, but you must turn in the direction of the arrow.
It only works if there is also a green circle light.

questions.correctAnswerText: It means you can go, but you must turn in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: A green arrow means you can go, but you must turn in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: How can you reduce the risk of hydroplaning?

options.text: Do not speed on wet roads.
Keep your tires filled to the right air pressure.

questions.explanation: Hydroplaning happens when your car slides on water between the tires and road. Tires with low air pressure or worn tread increase this risk. Speeding also increases it.

questions.question: A steady yellow traffic light means a ____ light will soon appear.
questions.explanation: A steady yellow light means a steady red light is coming next.

questions.question: You can drive across a dashed white line:

options.text: When it is safe to change lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: When it is safe to change lanes.
questions.explanation: Dashed white lines separate lanes going the same way. You can cross them to pass if it is safe.

questions.question: When crossing a railroad track with no signals or gates, you should:

options.text: Have the right-of-way and not check for trains.
Make sure your car can cross all the way without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure your car can cross all the way without stopping.
questions.explanation: Check that you have enough room to cross the tracks completely before driving on them. Never pass another car at a railroad crossing. Always look for trains before crossing any tracks.

questions.question: When a traffic signal light turns green, what should you do?

options.text: Speed up as fast as you can.
Wait for another driver to wave you on.

questions.explanation: A green light means you can go. But first, you must let pedestrians and other traffic already in the intersection pass.

questions.question: At dusk or on cloudy days, you should:
questions.explanation: You must turn on your headlights at dusk and on cloudy days. Use low beams when within 1,000 feet of an oncoming vehicle or within 500 feet of a vehicle ahead of you. Always use low beams in bad weather.

questions.question: If two drivers arrive at the same time to a four-way stop sign intersection, who has the right-of-way?

options.text: One driver can continue without stopping.
One driver should honk to give up the right-of-way.

questions.explanation: At a four-way stop, if two drivers arrive at the same time, the driver on your right has the right-of-way. You must yield to them. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: When do roads become very slippery?

options.text: When it has rained for an hour or more.
In the first 10 to 15 minutes of rain.

questions.correctAnswerText: In the first 10 to 15 minutes of rain.
questions.explanation: Roads are most slippery in the first 10 to 15 minutes of rain. The rain brings oil from the road surface up. Heat makes this worse by bringing up even more oil.

questions.question: What happens when you drink alcohol while taking drugs?
questions.explanation: Mixing alcohol and drugs can increase the effects of both. It is unsafe to drive after using either one, and even more dangerous when using both together.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: When turning left, you must yield to:

options.text: Other drivers already in the intersection.

questions.explanation: When turning left, you must yield to oncoming traffic. You must also always yield to pedestrians, bicyclists, and other drivers already in the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that the area ahead has low clearance.

questions.question: What technique helps drivers avoid crashes on icy or snowy roads?

options.text: Add extra weight to improve traction.
Get off highways as quickly as possible.
Reduce speed and increase following distance.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reduce speed and increase following distance.
questions.explanation: Slow down on snowy or icy roads and increase your following distance. These are the best ways to avoid crashes in bad winter weather.

questions.question: What do orange signs mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs mark work zones on highways. These diamond-shaped signs have black letters or symbols and warn that workers are on or near the road.

questions.question: When entering a highway from an entrance ramp, you should generally:

options.text: Speed up faster than traffic to get ahead.
Enter slowly to avoid other vehicles.
Stop first, then slowly enter traffic.
Speed up to match the traffic speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Speed up to match the traffic speed.
questions.explanation: Use the acceleration lane to speed up. Turn on your signal, look for an opening, speed up to match traffic speed, and merge safely.

questions.question: Roads freeze quickly when they are:
questions.explanation: Shaded areas under trees or buildings freeze faster than the rest of the road. They are also the last areas to dry.

questions.question: You must stop for a school bus:

options.text: That is parked on the shoulder with no one in it.
When it approaches you, even without flashing lights.
When its red lights are flashing on a two-lane road, in both directions.
Whenever the driver waves at you.

questions.correctAnswerText: When its red lights are flashing on a two-lane road, in both directions.
questions.explanation: Stop when a school bus displays flashing red lights while picking up or dropping off children. On a two-lane road, traffic from both directions must stop while the lights are flashing or the stop arm is extended.

questions.question: You may drive around the gates at a railroad crossing:

options.text: When the lights have stopped flashing.

questions.explanation: Always stop at railroad crossings when warning signals appear. Do not go around a lowered gate. Warning signals include flashing red lights, lowered gates, flaggers, or train horns.

questions.question: Downward-facing triangular signs mean:
questions.explanation: Downward-facing triangular signs tell drivers to yield. You may go when the road is clear and safe.

questions.question: Mixing drugs with alcohol:

options.text: Is no more dangerous than alcohol alone.
Reduces the effect of alcohol on driving.

questions.explanation: Drugs (illegal, prescription, or over-the-counter) can impair driving. Combining them with alcohol greatly increases crash risk.

questions.question: When you see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights, you must:

options.text: Slow down and stay in your lane.
Pull to the right and stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull to the right and stop.
questions.explanation: When you see flashing lights or hear a siren, pull to the right side of the road immediately and stop.

questions.question: Drowsy drivers:

options.text: Should drink strong black coffee to stay awake.
Can drive as poorly as drunk drivers.
Can stay alert by opening a window or turning up the radio.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can drive as poorly as drunk drivers.
questions.explanation: Drowsy drivers may drive so poorly they look drunk. Coffee, open windows, and loud radio are not enough to fix drowsiness.

questions.question: Road rage can be reduced by:
questions.explanation: Reduce road rage by using turn signals, obeying speed limits, and allowing plenty of extra travel time.

questions.question: When approaching a railroad crossing warning sign, you should:

options.text: Try to drive faster than the train.
Be ready to stop if a train is coming.
Look for a way around any lowered gates.
Assume no trains are nearby and drive normally.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop if a train is coming.
questions.explanation: Railroad crossing signs warn of possible trains. Always obey the sign and never go around barriers.
